newsitem.title: USA: ABN AMRO Chicago to buy Citicorp futures.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO Chicago to buy Citicorp futures.

text.p: ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Monday it agreed to acquire the futures activities of Citicorp.
The deal is scheuled to occur on or before March 31 and is subject to regulatory approval, the firm said.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said it would conduct futures transactions on behalf of Citicorp's affiliates and customers.

"Citicorp futures is a great fit for our business as they are active traders in Eurodollars and other financial products around the world," James Gary, executive vice president of ABN AMRO Chicago Corp Futures Group, said in a statement.
The firm said Citicorp futures employs about 150 people and has offices in Chicago, New York, London and Singapore.
In January, Netherlands-based ABN AMRO acquired Chicago Corp and merged it with its ABN AMRO Securities (USA) Inc to form ABN AMRO Chicago Corp.
One source close to the deal said ABN AMRO Chicago paid about $20 million for Citicorp futures.
The source also said Citicorp would continue to hold some of its seats on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange and the Chicago Board of Trade to retain member clearing rates.
